name: Oversight
tagline: Tracks bills, votes, lobbying and campaign money, with AI summaries that show how funding meets legislation.
problem: Government data is complex and money's influence is hard to see.
solution: Combines bill updates, campaign-finance and lobbying data, maps and news; Gemini summarises bills, highlights contested parts and scores polarisation.
demo_moment: Team-described: open a trending bill and see the money behind it.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “Best Consumer Hack by Terac” among 160 submissions.
Uses public finance data citizens rarely see together.

lessons: Join two public datasets nobody shows together.
